description: This file contains Python source code for a JSON schema parser and code generator, including class definitions for JSON types, schema loading, and reference handling.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class for JSON schema types, handling name, description, and type properties.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: Represents a null type in JSON schema.

classes.name: JsonBoolean
classes.description: Represents a boolean type in JSON schema.

classes.name: JsonInteger
classes.description: Represents an integer type with size and sign properties.

classes.name: AuxJsonInteger
classes.description: Generated auxiliary integer type.

classes.name: AuxJsonAuto
classes.description: Generated auto type for integers.

classes.name: JsonNumber
classes.description: Represents a floating point number type.

classes.name: JsonString
classes.description: Represents a string type.

classes.name: JsonInstanceId
classes.description: Represents an instance ID type.

classes.name: JsonRefCounted
classes.description: Handles reference counting for JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonTime
classes.description: Represents a time type with specific format handling.

classes.name: JsonMacAddress
classes.description: Represents a MAC address type.

classes.name: JsonEnum
classes.description: Represents an enumeration type with size and value handling.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object with properties, nested objects, and enums.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array with item type.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Represents a method with parameters and result schema.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Represents a notification schema.

classes.name: JsonCallback
classes.description: Represents a callback schema.

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a property with read/write attributes.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents a full JSON RPC schema with methods, properties, and info.

methods.name: Tstring
methods.description: Returns a string wrapped in _T() macro.

methods.name: Scoped
methods.description: Generates scope string for JSON objects based on hierarchy.

methods.name: CoreJson
methods.description: Constructs a core JSON type string with prefix.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates object type name with suffix.

methods.name: MakeEnum
methods.description: Creates enum type name with suffix.

methods.name: JsonItem
methods.description: Factory function to create JSON type objects based on schema.

methods.name: LoadSchema
methods.description: Loads and processes a JSON schema file, resolving references and includes.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Main entry point to load schemas from a file path.
